name: After § 6
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 6a. Stresses that the establishment of any permanent or autonomous EU body in the field of democratic resilience must be based on a clear and appropriate legal basis in the Treaties and must fully respect the principles of conferral, subsidiarity and proportionality; considers that no such body should be established or endowed with new powers before these requirements have been demonstrated;
